notes.title: "Take Control" Update brings VR Controller Support and 25+ songs to Unplugged!
notes.content:
Hi there, Rockstars! We have an exciting update coming in hot: The Controller Update brings controller support to Unplugged, letting you rock out without using hand/finger tracking!

We've spent a lot of time designing a way that works with the required inputs and we're very excited to hear what you think of it! It may seem simple at first, but once you take it up to Hard Mode, it will be the true test of shredding riffs for you!

This update makes Unplugged: Air Guitar compatible with HTC Vive (Pro), Meta Rift (S), Valve Index and Windows Mixed Reality headsets + controllers. Additionally, this update comes with 25+ new tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40717457/245bf993217f3c6ff8644ef45e159f70afebbed1.png[/img]

We want to give a big shout-out to the players for being part of our rock journey and making the continued development possible for Unplugged: Air Guitar. Keep on rockin', we hope to see you climb on the leaderboards!

-Anotherway & Vertigo Games

notes.title: Controller update and new songs!
notes.content:
[b]Controller update and New Songs[/b]

[i][u][i][b]*Now fully playable with controllers or hand-tracking*[/b][/i][/u][/i]

Play air guitar and write rock history in VR! Unplugged lets you rock out to some of the biggest and most insanely cool songs from world-famous rock bands, including The Offspring, Weezer & Ozzy Osbourne. Become a rock legend with Steel Panther’s inimitable frontman Satchel as your mentor.

Produced by the lead guitarist of Guitar Hero, playing air guitar has never felt this real. Pick up your virtual guitar, select a song, match your movement to the chords, strumat the right time and engage the crowd! Unlock songs, venues, guitars and more on your way to rock stardom and compete with the world’s best air guitarists.

• Go on an epic journey celebrating 5 decades of rock
• Unlock venues, songs and gear on your rise to fame
• Jam out to 50+ rock hits in 4 difficulty modes
• Become a rock legend on the global leaderboards
• Choose to play the entire game using just your hands, or pick up your controllers

notes.title: Let's rock into the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
It's been a year filled of gamers becoming Rockstars in Unplugged: Air Guitar and we couldn't be more proud of the journey we've taken with you! At Vertigo Games and Anotherway, we hope you're enjoying the stage in Unplugged and hope you will nominate us in this year's Steam Awards!

The team is very thankful for your part in the community, keep on rocking!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882211/Unplugged__Pantera_Pack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1882211/Unplugged__Pantera_Pack/[/url]

notes.title: Refreshing the songs with new note charts!

Hi rockstars!

We've updated Unplugged: Air Guitar with new note charts to bring it to parity with the other platforms Unplugged is available on for a uniform air guitar experience. Keep on rocking!
Anotherway & Vertigo Games

notes.title: Time to ROCK ON! Unplugged is available now for PCVR!
notes.content:
Unplugged is out now for PC VR* with a new, free update that makes its way to Quest as well.

A fresh, exclusive song "Unplug Yourself" from Steel Panther is a tailor-made track for Unplugged and can be heard in the game first!

Check out our teaser of this new banger!

[previewyoutube=xbVTxLjhYLg;full][/previewyoutube]

*Valve Index Controller-supported headsets only

All the finetuning from the Quest version made it into the PCVR release and here's all the new features you'll find in this new update:

[h3][b]🎸 New Track from Steel Panther "Unplug Yourself" 🎸[/b][/h3]
We enjoyed our collaboration with Steel Panther a lot, and the feeling was mutual! They composed a new song just for Unplugged, now available for you to hit the leaderboards on!

[h3]✨[b]"Easy Peasy" Difficulty mode[/b]✨ [/h3]
Sometimes you just wanna rock out and work on your legendary stage presence; Easy Peasy mode will allow you just go through your journey to stardom with Satchel all chilled out!

[h3][b]🔍 Pass-through (Quest-only) 🔎[/b][/h3]
With Quest Passthrough, you will blend the game's virtual stage with your living room. Rocking the stage and seeing your family and friends cheer you on as you play is a perfect combination that comes right on time for the holidays!

Here's a refresher of our setlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40717457/cc8e275323fd697bc91083ee4a2d7ca9deec7278.jpg[/img]

With a setlist of over 20 songs, you'll get to rock out hard to some of the biggest rock songs! Become a rock legend with Steel Panther's Satchel as your mentor.

See you on stage!
